title: Nothing Phone 4b Specifications: Confirmed Design and Leaks Explained
meta_description: See confirmed Nothing Phone 4b specifications, regional battery and network differences, official colours, cameras, display and which old leaks were wrong.
excerpt: A post-launch fact-check of Nothing Phone 4b design and specifications, separating official global and regional details from outdated leaks, concepts and assumptions.
author: Nothing Pakistan Editorial Team

faqs.question: What are the confirmed Nothing Phone 4b specifications?
faqs.answer: Confirmed international highlights include Snapdragon 6 Gen 4, 8 GB RAM, UFS 2.2 storage, a 6.77-inch 120 Hz AMOLED display, 50 MP stabilised main camera, ultrawide, 16 MP front camera, 5,200 mAh battery, 33 W charging, IP64 and Nothing OS 4.1.

faqs.question: Is the Nothing Phone 4b officially released?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Phone 4b has been officially announced and listed for sale by Nothing. Articles that still describe every specification as a leak should be treated as pre-launch material.

faqs.question: Which processor does Phone 4b use?
faqs.answer: Nothing officially lists the 4 nm Qualcomm Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 platform, with an eight-core CPU up to 2.3 GHz, Adreno 810 GPU and Qualcomm AI engine.

faqs.question: Does Nothing Phone 4b have a 6,000 mAh battery?
faqs.answer: The 6,000 mAh capacity applies to the India version. The official international specification lists 5,200 mAh. Buyers must identify the regional unit rather than combining specifications from different markets.

faqs.question: Does Phone 4b have one or two rear cameras?
faqs.answer: The confirmed hardware includes a 50 MP main camera and an ultrawide camera. Pre-launch discussion that treated the phone as having only one rear camera is outdated.

faqs.question: Does Phone 4b support 4K video?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nothing lists rear-camera 4K recording at 30 fps, plus 1080p at 30 or 60 fps and additional slow-motion and time-lapse modes.

faqs.question: What colours are official for Nothing Phone 4b?
faqs.answer: Nothing lists White, Black and Blue, with Blue identified as web-exclusive in the detailed specification. Regional availability can differ.

faqs.question: Does Phone 4b have a Glyph Matrix?
faqs.answer: No. Phone 4b uses the Glyph Bar. Concepts and speculation about a Phone 3-style Glyph Matrix should not be presented as confirmed Phone 4b hardware.

faqs.question: Is Phone 4b water resistant?
faqs.answer: Nothing lists IP64 certification for dust and water resistance and an additional controlled shallow-water test. IP64 is not permission for swimming or deliberate immersion, and damage coverage depends on warranty terms.

faqs.question: How long will Nothing Phone 4b receive updates?
faqs.answer: Nothing promises three years of Android updates and six years of security patches, counted from the model's first availability on nothing.tech.

faqs.question: Does Phone 4b support eSIM and NFC?
faqs.answer: The detailed specification marks eSIM as Japan-only. NFC is listed for international markets with India excluded. Confirm the exact regional SKU before purchase.

faqs.question: Are the official Phone 4b specifications enough to prove Pakistan compatibility?
faqs.answer: No. Check the exact regional band list, genuine dual-SIM IMEIs, PTA status, operator behaviour, warranty and seller return terms for the unit being offered.
